definition: Normal support witness W with finite support set S and selected lexicographic support tuple.
input_witness_condition: W is in support normal form and support_size(W)>8
active_support_condition: active support A is defined from W
relation_to_family_chain_lift: May be recognized family-chain or non-family-chain.
relation_to_higher_support_escape: Non-normal input is outside current operation.

definition: A is the union of payload, certificate, frontier/shell/tail, canonical motif, and family-chain lift dependency coordinates.
input_witness_condition: normal witness exposes these dependency fields
active_support_condition: A subset S and contains all required fields
relation_to_family_chain_lift: Family-chain fields are retained if present.
relation_to_higher_support_escape: If A cannot be computed, projection is named failure.
caveat: Completeness of dependency extraction remains proof-sketch.

definition: The operation applies when A is a strict subset of S.
counterexample_status_effect: certificate remains only if contained in A
relation_to_family_chain_lift: Recognized source form can persist if all recognizer fields are in A.
relation_to_higher_support_escape: If A=S, this operation is no-op and routes to next operation.

definition: Restrict every witness component to A and renormalize by selected support normal form.
input_witness_condition: A is well-defined and contains required fields
payload_effect: payload relation should be preserved on A
canonicalization_effect: canonicalization commutes only up to reindexing
counterexample_status_effect: counterexample certificate transfers when all status fields are in A
relation_to_family_chain_lift: family-chain lift fields remain if included in A
relation_to_higher_support_escape: Failure to renormalize is named projection blocker.

definition: Payload rows are restricted to active coordinates, preserving/refining source-target payload relation when all payload coordinates are in A.
relation_to_family_chain_lift: family-chain payload preserved if family fields subset A
caveat: Full payload-refinement proof is not completed.

definition: Counterexample status transfers if certificate/status fields are included in A; otherwise operation fails rather than preserving status.
counterexample_status_effect: preserved or reduced to smaller witness under certificate containment
relation_to_family_chain_lift: family-chain status preserved only under recognized-source compatibility

definition: If A equals S, projection creates no smaller witness.
input_witness_condition: W in active support normal form
relation_to_higher_support_escape: not higher-support until all operations fail

definition: If active support is ill-defined, omits required fields, or projection cannot be normalized, the case is named.
relation_to_family_chain_lift: may route outside family-chain source form
relation_to_higher_support_escape: Higher-support escape only after operation taxonomy exhausted.

definition: Project-to-active semantics are first-class and proof-ready with strict measure decrease under proper active subset.
active_support_condition: A computed; A proper subset required
support_effect: negative support_size when active subset strict
relation_to_higher_support_escape: named operation failure if preconditions absent
caveat: Not all operation proofs or full theorem proved.
